profile.headline: Retired Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Application Developer and Project Leader in a variety of business applications. Interested in client/server and J2EE enterprise development. Also skilled in relational database design and application using Oracle.  Interested in web application projects as a project leader and software engineer.

Specialties: Strong experience in developing J2EE applications using BEA Weblogic application server and Oracle RDBMS. Also experienced in Webshere MQ programming. Familiar with Swift protocol.

positions.title: Project Leader/Software Engineer
positions.description:
V.P. level Software Engineer and Project Leader in the Citi Markets and Banking technology division serving the Global Transaction Services unit Cash Management systems. 
 
Design and develop J2EE Internet-facing web applications using Weblogic and WebSphere Application servers, Oracle RDBMS, Solaris and AIX. Provide hands on front and back end J2EE development as well as function as project leader, gathering business requirements, creating specifications and project plans, supervising on and off shore resources, progressing the project life cycle from design to release and deployment.  

Project lead to migrate Solaris J2EE web applications, Java and script processing to IBM AIX. Migration includes Weblogic to WebSphere application server, supervision of off-shore resources, system and network integration, project plan and scheduling in addition to development. 

Project lead for Swift messaging repair analysis reporting application providing PDF reports using Java, Hibernate, Oracle database and supervising off-shore resources.

Project leader of MVC front-end design team developing the web application GUI for internet facing funds transfer reporting application using JSP, JavaScript, DHTML and JQuery.  Managed and supervised on-site and off-shore resources, created web design using Dreamweaver and created data model for Oracle database. 

Business rule implementation in JDBC, PL/SQL for J2EE Web application including user, account and entitlement administration in Java and Oracle.

Messaging system development using Java, MQ Series, JMS and CORBA to receive, transform and load data. Designed application and interface definition with partner applications. 

Project lead specifying application data flow and security for firewall policy and network configuration.

positions.title: Project Leader/Web Developer/Software Engineer/
positions.description:
Web site development and modifications.
HTML, DHTML, CSS, Javascript, PHP, SQL, XML, JSON, JQuery

Software Engineering services specializing in J2EE, Oracle, JDBC,  PL/SQL, Java, MQ Series, Aix, Solaris and HP Unix platforms.

positions.title: Technical Director
positions.description: Project lead and engineer of a B2B e-Commerce web site specializing in fine jewelry and diamond sales.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
•	Directed application development and maintenance of the electronic distribution system for various customer data delivery systems in C/C++. 
•	Application manager for various application and presentation services for electronic news feed systems in C/C++ and Oracle.
